text:
Run two jobs at once: set [parallel] max_concurrency in athena.toml from 1 to 2. The first try changed only athena.toml and three drain tests failed because they read the real athena.toml and assume max_concurrency 1 (a_change_to_max_concurrency_alone_does_not_invalidate_a_reading, parallel::every_landing_path_ends_in_reinstall_for_any_unreadable_config, unreadable_at_reports_what_the_running_schema_rejects). Make those tests independent of the live value, without weakening what they check.

Files changed: athena.toml and crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs.

Acceptance:
- athena.toml has max_concurrency = 2 and no other change
- the three named tests pass and still check what they checked before
- cargo test --locked passes
